items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was just knocked out by the way Zinky played the piano

ctx.x: The Ruby at Club, with Zinky Cohn on the piano. Oh, you guys -- I used to hear you on the radio, and Zinky was -- well, I had heard Zinky, but he came to Detroit once with Jimmy Noon's band, and I never heard of him, and I was just knocked out by the way Zinky played the piano.
Well, he was the same sound like --
